caption: The drawing depicts six square blocks arranged in two vertical columns and three horizontal rows on a plain, off-white background. Each square block is subdivided into four triangular sections with different patterns and colors, resembling quilt squares. The colors primarily include blue, yellow, brown, red, tan, beige, green, cream, and white, with various patterns such as floral, stripes, checks, and swirls. The top row has one square with blue floral triangles and yellow striped triangles, and another with muted greens and reds on floral backgrounds. The middle row shows a combination of orange and dark brown floral patterns in one square, and a second square with red, beige, and green patterns separated by thin yellow and purple stripes. The bottom row has one square with a mix of olive green, blue, and cream triangles with floral designs and a second square primarily brown with smaller blue flowers and orange plaid with white stripes. All the blocks are evenly spaced and centered on the page.
title: Quilt Swatches
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
